visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women are framed from the chest up against a plain white studio backdrop. The woman on the left has long dark hair and wears a white ruffled shirt. The woman on the right has short dark hair, wearing a black shirt with a prominent gold dragon print and a thick gold chain. Yellow text overlays the center. (2) The scene cuts to a full-length shot in a large indoor studio with wooden floors. The short-haired woman stands with a tough posture, while the long-haired woman, wearing a grey pleated skirt, clings to her arm with a pleading facial expression. Studio gear like rolls of backdrop paper and clothes racks are visible in the background. (3) The woman in the dragon shirt attempts to lift the long-haired woman by the waist in a display of strength. Her face transitions from a stoic expression to one of extreme physical strain. The lifted woman begins to tilt sideways as they lose balance. (4) The scene transitions into a blooper style. Both women are laughing uncontrollably. The short-haired woman is sitting on the floor after failing the lift, while the other woman stands nearby, laughing and pointing. White variety-show style question marks and action lines flash around them. (5) Final shot shows the short-haired woman sitting on the floor looking at the camera with a wide grin. Large white text appears at the bottom of the screen covering her legs.
